      • receiveEvent

        public void receiveEvent(org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent event)
        Dispatches a click within this GUI to its slot handlers.
        Implementation Note:
        The try/finally cancels the event even when a handler throws, so a handler bug can never leave the click uncancelled and let a player pull items out of the GUI.
